title: Daisy Fuentes Joins “Soul Searching with Chiquis” to Talk Turning 60, Beauty Standards and Keeping Romance Alive in New Episode From iHeartMedia’s My Cultura Podcast Network
summary: iHeartMedia is a leading global media and entertainment company specializing in radio, digital, mobile, social, live events and on-demand entertainment.
body_markdown:
*Listen to the episode now*[HERE](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-soul-searching-with-chiqu-88620832/episode/the-evolution-of-daisy-fuentes-a-journey-of-self-discovery-love-legacy-and-empowerment-350611765/)


**WHAT:**[“Soul Searching with Chiquis”](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-soul-searching-with-chiqu-88620832/) , from iHeartMedia’s My Cultura Podcast Network, will welcome television personality, model and entrepreneur Daisy Fuentes for a candid conversation about aging, self-worth, marriage and building a career beyond television. Fuentes will discuss her path from local weather reporting to MTV VJ and will deep dive into how she built a fashion and lifestyle brand that younger shoppers recognize independently of her television career.


During the episode, Chiquis will sit down with Fuentes to reflect on turning 60, how she once believed her looks defined her worth, the criticism she continues to receive on social media and why judgment from other women particularly bothers her.


Fuentes will also open up about adjusting to changes in her marriage, sharing advice on growing together, maintaining romance, continuing to choose each other and the compliment from her husband that she considers one of the nicest things a man has ever said to her.


**WHEN:** The episode of “Soul Searching with Chiquis” featuring Daisy Fuentes premieres today, November 23, 2026.


**WHERE:**[“Soul Searching with Chiquis”](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-soul-searching-with-chiqu-88620832/) is part of iHeartMedia’s My Cultura Podcast Network, which is dedicated to elevating Latinx voices and creators and sharing the Latinx experience with millions of listeners. The podcast is available on the iHeartRadio app and everywhere podcasts are heard.


**WHO:** Chiquis is a singer, entrepreneur and podcast host. On “Soul Searching with Chiquis,” she shares personal reflections and conversations about relationships, self-discovery and personal growth.


Daisy Fuentes is a television personality, model and entrepreneur who broke barriers as MTV’s first Latina VJ and Revlon’s first Latina spokesperson. Her career spans television, fashion and beauty, including her work on MTV’s “House of Style” and the development of her fashion and lifestyle brand.


**About My Cultura Podcast Network**


iHeartMedia’s My Cultura Podcast Network launched May 2021 in collaboration with Enrique Santos, iHeartMedia’s top-rated on-air personality and President and Chief Creative Officer of iHeartLatino, and has since welcomed actor, producer, entrepreneur and activist Wilmer Valderrama along with Eva Longoria and her studio Hyphenate Media Group as stakeholders. Since launch, the network has seen steady listener growth and has become home to more than 60 podcasts including hit series “[Suite 305 with Lele Pons](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-suite-305-with-lele-pons-336591965) ,” “[Bleep! with Ana Navarro](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-bleep-with-ana-navarro-323311725/) ,” “[Latino USA](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-latino-usa-28457181) ,” “[Against All Odds with Yris Palmer](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-against-all-odds-with-yri-327129588/) ,” “[Agushto Papá](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-agushto-papa-podcast-268229027/) ,” “[How Hard Can It Be? with Diana Maria Riva](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-how-hard-can-it-be-with-d-332097714) ,” “[No Safe Words with October and Tony Gonzalez](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-no-safe-words-with-octobe-341576345) ,” “[Soul Searching with Chiquis](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-chiquis-and-chill-88620832/) ,” Wilmer Valderrama’s “[Dos Amigos](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-dos-amigos-258774901) ,” “[Hungry for History with Eva Longoria and Maite Gomez-Rejón](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-hungry-for-history-with-e-102809913) ,” "[Magical Rewind,](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-magical-rewind-143845990/) ” “[Tengo Testimonio with Jorge Lozano](https://www.iheart.com/search?q=tengo+testimonio) ,” “[Radio Ambulante](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-radio-ambulante-28457191/) ," “[Enrique Santos Podcast](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-enrique-santos-60735270/) ,” and many more.
